origin: Produced by running Dovecot 2.3.21 (image dovecot/dovecot:2.3.21), not copied from documentation or a public dataset. Captured on 2026-10-15 on the author's laptop by testbed/heldout_r2/dovecot_auth.sh, two runs driven with different words (run A -> samples, run B -> scenario events).
review_status: DRAFT - every field below awaits the author's review
notes: FREE TEXT WITH KEY=VALUE INSIDE, AND THE REPORTER IS ONE OF THE ENDPOINTS. `rip` is the client and `lip` is the server's own address: the destination of the connection AND the device writing the line. destination.ip is drafted because rules about a flow read the destination; observer.ip is defensible and the author must decide. Two line shapes - the login processes and the auth process - carry the client address under different syntax. The capture names are fixed in documentation.md, as for every free-text source.

fields.note: `Login` or a disconnection with its cause. event.action takes the source's own vocabulary; an outcome would need a value map over a free-text phrase.
